title: SaaS Landing Page Plan
originalSpec: Build a responsive SaaS landing page that clearly presents the product value proposition, pricing plans, and FAQ content, so visitors can quickly understand the offering and convert through prominent calls to action. Success looks like a clean, componentized implementation that compiles successfully, renders all required sections, and keeps each file small and focused.
